# EmailFlow

> EmailFlow is a London-based email marketing agency serving UK ecommerce stores. We work exclusively with Omnisend. Core services cover lifecycle flows, campaigns, segmentation and deliverability support.

## Services
- [Ecommerce email management](https://www.emailflow.uk/ecommerce-email-marketing-agency/)
- [Omnisend agency support](https://www.emailflow.uk/omnisend-agency/)
- [Shopify email marketing](https://www.emailflow.uk/shopify-email-marketing-agency/)
- [Email automation](https://www.emailflow.uk/email-automation/)

## Scope and measurement
Management is advertised at £800/month; the proposal confirms deliverables, campaign frequency, software charges and additional work. Core implementation may follow a seven-day plan after access, content and approvals are ready. Revenue growth, list growth and inbox placement are not guaranteed. Platform-attributed revenue does not establish incremental store growth. Case studies describe individual accounts and should be read with their measurement limitations.
